description:
The namespaces of an installation and who belongs to them: the domain
        (NamespaceDefinition), the port (NamespaceRepository) and the service that
        creates namespaces, invites members and answers what a user may work in.
        Installation-wide like the users — everything else lives inside a
        namespace. No framework and no storage — the adapters live in
        mc-namespace (file, memory) and mc-namespace-pg.
